newsitem.title: MEXICO: Pemex updates average crude port shipping volumes.
newsitem.headline: Pemex updates average crude port shipping volumes.

text.p: Mexico's state oil and gas monopoly Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) on Monday gave updated average shipping volumes for the nation's main three crude ports in 1996.

Top crude shipping port Cayo Arcas in Campeche state exported an average 576,300 barrels per day (bpd) for the year, down from an average 611,000 bpd for the first three quarters. a Pemex spokeswoman told Reuters.
Dos Bocas in Tabasco state saw exports rise for the year to about 505,900 bpd, from an average 440,000 bpd for the first nine months.
Shipping volume at Pajaritos in Veracruz state also rose from the previous estimates, to 416,200 bpd for 1996, from an average 399,000 bpd in the first nine months.
Mexico exported about 1.54 million bpd of crude in 1996.
